page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a page number and running head at the top. The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of the lines. Small marks in the left margin are not text.

main_text.l: sum est ipsi melius, quodque si e duobu[?]
alterum ipsi esset jam nunc necessari[?]
videtu[?] non posse honeste recusari, quod fui[?]
certum finem promissum est, a promitt[?]
cutus est suum finem; quia omne su[?]
onalis obligatio. Sed pactus cum latr[?]
ne precium, eo fine id fecit ut vitam si[?]
Quarto, suspecta debet esse semper pru-
dentia carnis, ut inimica cordis puritat[?]
e[?] si haec non fit, ubi videtur honestas cu[?]
quod utile est amplecti? Vix poterit c[?]
rare, cui potiores sunt divitiis religio

page.notes: Right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of most lines; words there are marked [?] or left partial. Long s is transcribed as s. The italic markers on Tertiò, Quarto, Quinto and Regulus are read from the scan. "infidiosa" is read as "insidiosa" from a doubtful glyph. Small dot-like marks in the left margin are not text and are not transcribed.
